title: Deliver Wood to Denley Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Denley Sawmill** (industry id 2, near tile 61,62).

A likely supplier is **Denley Forest** (industry id 3, near tile 72,86); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **280 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
